title: [finding] driver-memory keeps a THIRD refusal wording for the same dateRange condition — the tree is at two wordings, not one, after #18232
body:
Reported by the `domain:services` dev that delivered **#18275** (card #18232) as an out-of-scope finding, and filed here by the seat.

⚠️ **Filed by the seat because the dev's dedupe control FAILED, and that is stated rather than hidden.** Its one targeted semantic search did not return **#18232 itself** — the known-must-hit control for this exact subject — so the empty result was not a reading, and it refused to file on it. ⭐ That refusal is correct: an empty result from an instrument that cannot be shown to hit a known positive is worth nothing. ⛔ This card therefore carries NO dedupe claim; establishing whether a duplicate exists is part of triage's work here, not a step this seat is pretending was done.

## The finding

`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics.ts` has its own local `explicitDateRangeWindow` that overwrites `err.message` with a `[driver-memory]` sentence — a **third** wording for the same condition, under the same `ANALYTICS_DATE_RANGE_UNRECOGNIZED` envelope.

The rule it violates is quoted in `packages/spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts`'s own prose, the `#5240` convention:

> the refusal is shared by the schema door (this file) and, through the `ANALYTICS_DATE_RANGE_UNRECOGNIZED` envelope, by the runtime door and the drivers (#16322), so **one condition keeps one wording**

⚠️ Note "**and the drivers**" — the convention names this package explicitly.

## Why it is filed NOW and what it means for #18232

PR #18275 removes the `service-analytics` face's second wording. ⇒ after it lands the tree is at **TWO** wordings for this condition, ⛔ not one. Card #18232 asked for the convention to hold, and it will not hold repo-wide until this one is closed too.

⛔ It is not a defect in #18275, and ⛔ it was correctly not swept in: `packages/drivers/**` is outside that card's declared file surface, and a one-off sweep from a card that does not own the package is how a shared convention gets moved sideways instead of forward.

Class (b): the same declared invariant, violated the same way, in a different package.

## Successor

Whoever holds `domain:engine` / `driver-memory`. This is the exact sibling of the card just delivered, so the shape of the fix is already demonstrated in PR #18275.

---

Dedupe words: `driver-memory` `memory-analytics` `explicitDateRangeWindow` `third wording` `#5240`

⛔ Ungraded on purpose, and ⛔ no `domain:` label — the surface is `packages/drivers/**`, which is not this seat's to route. Grading and routing are triage's.
